x: Biometric authentication technology is not an ESSO area. ESSO (2007, Ministry of Earth Sciences) covers ocean science and technology, atmospheric and climate science, geoscience, and polar science and the cryosphere.

CIMAP (1959) works on medicinal and aromatic plants. The others are wrong: CECRI (1948) works on electrochemistry and batteries, not food technology (that is CFTRI). NCL (1950) works on chemistry, not measurement standards (that is NPL, 1947). NGRI (1961) works on geophysics, not oceanography (that is NIO, 1966).

IGCAR, Kalpakkam does fast breeder reactor R&D. The others are wrong: NPCIL builds and runs nuclear power plants. The Heavy Water Board, not AERB, produces heavy water, and AERB is the safety regulator. IREL handles beach-sand minerals and rare earths, not reactors.

Dhruva is the largest of the BARC research reactors. The others are wrong: Apsara was Asia's first research reactor, KAMINI is the only U-233-fuelled reactor, and Dhruva is a research reactor, not a cyclotron.
V. Narayanan is the ISRO Chairman (Jan 2026). Samir V. Kamat is the DRDO Chairman and Secretary, DDR&D; the Space Commission is chaired by the Secretary, DoS, who is the ISRO Chairman.

All four statements are correct. The Space Commission was constituted in 1972 along with DoS. It is chaired by the Secretary, DoS, who is also the ISRO Chairman, and DoS reports directly to the Prime Minister.
